description:
We are looking to hire engineers, IT professionals, to join our growing team in Bucharest. Our new colleagues will be part of the team involved in activities related to the supervision and administration of an extended IT network/equipment (servers, virtual machines, routers and firewalls etc.)

The Ideal Candidate :

  • Experienced in network administration and/or in MS or Linux server installation, configuration and maintenance
  • Storage and virtualization experience (Xen experience is a plus)
  • Network administration, routing and maintenance skills
  • Linux (shell, configuration, networking)
  • University Degree - Computer Science or related
  • Team player, good relational skills

Will be considered a plus any of the following:

  • Apache Tomcat and/or SQL Database configuration and administration experience
  • Microsoft or CISCO certification(s)
  • IT security knowledge / certification
  • ITIL and system ticketing knowledge
  • Good written and spoken English

Your duties will include:

  • Participate in the design, development, implementation and optimization of IT networks
  • Monitor and supervise apps and/or IT equipment / network
  • IT Systems supervision and maintenance will include (as per your qualification) one or many of the following areas:
    • CISCO administration, configuration and maintenance (routers, firewalls, etc)
    • MS and/or LINUX servers administration, configuration and maintenance
    • Virtualization (Virtual machines creation, maintenance and optimization)
    • Network supervision and deployment management
    • Storage and Back Up systems configuration and administration
    • IT network security and monitoring

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary package and benefits
  • Interesting and complex projects to be a part of
  • Training and career development opportunities
  • Young, dynamic, talented and motivated team
  • Professional and friendly working environment in centrally located location

Our Company:
We design, develop, operate and maintain complex HW networks and SW applications for local and international partners.
